risk_note: RV2 (union/**). Pinduoduo adapter request base only: MD5 signing (official vector), flat JSON POST with credentials injected per call and Clock seconds, https-only fetch transport (redirect error, sanitized failures), registered outer keys, error_response classification to UnionError with warnings for 20004/20005/70035, port methods adapter_unimplemented and no optional ports. No platform field mapping (AGENTS §4-7; approvals 28 for later tasks); the registry does not assemble it yet, so runtime behaviour on main is unchanged. Written by hand.
